lines.text: Jesus warns that stumbling blocks will come, and causing a little one to stumble is worse than a millstone and the sea.
If a brother sins ten times in a day and says "I repent," forgive him; the apostles ask for more faith.
Mustard seed faith could make a fig tree be uprooted and planted in the sea.
A servant from the field must prepare his master's meal and serve him, and disciples should call themselves unworthy servants.
